name: Steamed rice
steps: Wash rice 2-3 times|Boil water in the pot, add rice|Cook until soft, drain and rest 5 min|Fluff and keep covered

name: Lemon rice
steps: Cook rice and cool slightly|Temper groundnuts and onion in oil|Mix with lemon juice and salt|Toss gently with rice

name: Tomato rice
steps: Saute onion, add chopped tomato and spices|Add washed rice and water|Cook until done|Rest and fluff

name: Bisibele bath
steps: Pressure-cook dal and rice together|Cook chopped vegetables with spice powder|Combine and simmer|Finish with ghee/tempering

name: Curd rice
steps: Cook rice soft and let it cool|Mix with curd and salt|Temper mustard and curry leaves|Serve chilled or at room temperature

name: Chapati
steps: Knead dough and rest 20 min|Roll into rounds|Cook on a hot griddle both sides|Stack in a cloth-lined box

name: Ragi mudde
steps: Boil water with salt|Add ragi flour and stir continuously|Cook on low heat until smooth|Shape into balls

name: Idli
steps: Use fermented batter (soak and ferment the day before)|Pour into greased idli plates|Steam 12-15 min|Serve hot

name: Dosa
steps: Use fermented batter (prepared the day before)|Spread on a hot griddle|Cook until crisp|Serve hot

name: Upma
steps: Roast rava lightly|Saute onion and vegetables|Add water and salt, bring to boil|Stir in rava and cover to cook

name: Poha
steps: Rinse poha and drain|Temper groundnuts, onion and diced potato|Add poha and turmeric|Warm through and finish with lemon

name: Pongal
steps: Dry-roast moong dal|Cook with rice until very soft|Temper pepper and cumin|Mix well

name: Sambar
steps: Pressure-cook dal|Cook vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder|Combine and simmer 10 min|Temper and serve hot

name: Dal tadka
steps: Pressure-cook dal until soft|Prepare tempering with onion and tomato|Mix into dal|Simmer 5 min

name: Chana masala
steps: Soak chana overnight|Pressure-cook until soft|Cook onion-tomato masala|Combine and simmer

name: Paneer butter masala
steps: Cube paneer|Cook onion-tomato gravy and blend|Add spices and cream/butter|Add paneer and simmer 5 min

name: Chicken curry
steps: Marinate chicken|Cook onion-tomato masala|Add chicken and cook until done (core temp 75 C)|Simmer in gravy

name: Egg curry
steps: Hard-boil eggs and peel|Cook onion-tomato masala|Add eggs and simmer 8 min|Garnish

name: Rasam
steps: Boil tomato with tamarind and rasam powder|Add cooked dal water|Temper|Serve hot

name: Aloo fry
steps: Boil and cube potatoes|Temper mustard, onion|Add potato and spices|Roast until golden

name: Cabbage poriyal
steps: Shred cabbage|Temper mustard and onion|Add cabbage and cook covered|Finish dry

name: Beans carrot palya
steps: Chop vegetables finely|Temper and add vegetables|Cook covered until tender|Add grated coconut if available

name: Cauliflower masala
steps: Cut florets|Cook onion-tomato masala|Add cauliflower and cook until tender|Dry-roast to finish

name: Brinjal curry
steps: Cut brinjal and keep in water|Cook onion-tomato masala|Add brinjal and cook covered|Simmer until soft

name: Mixed vegetable curry
steps: Chop all vegetables|Cook masala base|Add vegetables and water|Simmer until tender

name: Tomato chutney
steps: Saute onion and tomato|Cool|Grind with salt and chilli|Temper and serve

name: Onion raita
steps: Whisk curd|Add chopped onion and salt|Chill|Serve
